analysis: The method getSchemaForField retrieves a SchemaInformation from a map by name. If the name is not found in the map (i.e., schemaInformation is null), it throws a RuntimeException with a descriptive message. This indicates that the calling code should have ensured the field exists before calling this method, or that the absence of the field is an unexpected error. Since it's an unchecked exception (RuntimeException), the programmer did not require the caller to catch it; instead, it serves as an assertion that the field must exist. The exception will propagate up the call stack unless caught, but the design suggests it is meant to indicate a bug or invalid input rather than a recoverable condition.
